proof_body:
by
  intro A _ _ a k r hk
  rw [← spectrum.add_singleton_eq]
  have h := spectrum.unit_smul_eq_smul (R := ℂ) a (Units.mk0 k hk)
  have h' : spectrum ℂ (k • a) = spectrum ℂ (Units.mk0 k hk • a) := rfl
  rw [h', h]
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_add, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_smul_set, Set.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, _, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, _, rfl, rfl⟩
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (a : A) (k r : ℂ), k ≠ 0 → spectrum ℂ (k • a + algebraMap ℂ A r) = (fun z => k * z + r) '' spectrum ℂ a
